item.title: Hong Kong: High-Performance Materials Enable Smarter Tech
item.description: NAMI is developing advanced materials that enhance sustainability, performance and industrial capabilities across energy storage, construction, electronics, environmental solutions and healthcare applications.

item.title: India: Expanding Access to Next-Gen Chip Design and Innovation
item.description: India is empowering various universities and start-ups with advanced chip-design tools and fabrication services, accelerating semiconductor innovation and building a skilled technology workforce nationwide.

item.title: Singapore: MoE Promoting Healthier Screen Use in Students
item.description: MOE is introducing enhanced measures under Grow Well SG to promote healthier screen use, better sleep, physical activity, social engagement and overall well-being among secondary school students.

item.title: Australia: DNA Library Powers Tech-Driven Biodiversity Insights
item.description: Australia’s National Biodiversity DNA Library uses DNA, big data and advanced analytics to enable faster, more accurate monitoring and management of the country’s ecosystems and biodiversity.

item.title: The Philippines: Digital Literacy and Education for Young Women
item.description: The Philippines is advancing inclusive digital education and connectivity, empowering girls and youth with English and digital skills while expanding infrastructure, electrification and collaboration.

item.title: Malaysia: Selangor Accelerates High-Tech Investment Growth
item.description: Selangor is intensifying its focus on advanced, technology-driven industries to strengthen investment appeal, accelerate innovation-led growth and reinforce its position as Malaysia’s leading high-tech economic hub.

item.title: Indonesia: Updated AI Ethics Code Strengthens Fintech Security
item.description: Indonesia’s Financial Services Authority (OJK) has updated its AI ethics code to strengthen fintech security, enhance consumer protection and mitigate emerging risks from rapidly evolving AI-driven technologies.

item.title: Hong Kong: Programmable Soft Composite Materials Enable Intelligent Motion
item.description: HKUST researchers developed programmable soft composites with shear-jamming properties, enabling directional, resilient, adaptive responses for next-generation smart devices and soft robotics.

item.title: Vietnam: Biotech as Engine for Smart Economic Growth
item.description: Vietnam is accelerating its biotechnology strategy to transform research into commercial products, strengthen interdisciplinary collaboration and capture global growth in health, food and regenerative technologies.

item.title: Singapore: DC-CFA2 Drives Expansion of Sustainable Data Centre Capacity
item.description: Singapore is expanding its digital infrastructure through DC-CFA2 and SS 715:2025, promoting sustainable, energy-efficient data centres while fostering AI-driven innovation and digital talent.
